verdict.rationale: Cognee produces AI-generated insights from user data in several documented ways. `recall()` answers questions over the knowledge graph and picks a retrieval strategy automatically. `cognee-cli report` writes a Graph Insight Report describing what a dataset's graph contains. The browser UI lets you run searches over your data, and a Linear agent answers @mentions from memory. Missing for 10: any evidence of proactive suggestions or recommendations, the insight report is documented only as a CLI feature rather than inside the UI, the report is described in a single line, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
